programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Dà Sgadan
programme.desc: Two sisters have their relationship tested when the local gang show up at their place. Tha strì eadar dà phiuthar nuair a tha gràisg ionadail a’ nochdadh.

programme.title: Women’s Scottish Cup (BBC ALBA)
programme.desc: Ball-coise beò bho iar-chuairt dheireannach de Chupa Albannach nam Ban. Dà sgioba à Ghlaschu, Glasgow City agus Celtic beò à Hampden, a’ farpais san chiad iar-chuairt dheireannach airson àite sa chuairt dheireannach. Live football action from the women’s Scottish Cup competition semi-final stage. Two Glasgow teams, Glasgow City and Celtic, face each other at Hampden as a spot in the final is up for grabs.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Wallace 's Gromit
programme.desc: Tha Gromit a' tighinn an aghaidh strì uabhasach 's Wallace a' faireachdainn 'curran' neònach às dèidh deuchainn-saidheans. Wallace and Gromit's pest control business is called into action.

programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: Sreath ùr anns a bheil Linda NicLeòid a’ còcaireachd cuide ri a caraidean. An-diugh tha Fionnlagh agus Elizabeth cuide ri Linda airson sailead ioma-dhathach a dheasachadh le tuna, pasta agus glasraich de gach seòrsa, leithid pònairean uaine agus coirce Innseanach. Ach mus tòisich iad a’ còcaireachd, feumaidh iad dèanamh cinnteach gu bheil na tha a dhìth aca a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach cò às a tha coirce Innseanach a’ tighinn. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson an sailead ullachadh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd airson ithe! Linda Macleod and friends cook a number of tasty dishes. She is joined by Fionnlagh and Elizabeth to prepare a multi-coloured salad with tuna, pasta and vegetables, including green beans and sweetcorn. However, before they start, they must be sure they have all the ingredients - anything missing has to go on the shopping list. Linda and her friends learn more about sweetcorn and how it is grown before heading back into the kitchen to prepare the salad. Then it's a case of sitting down at the table and tucking in!

programme.title: Oscar & Ealasaid
programme.desc: Nuair a reothas I, tha e mar chleachdadh aig mathain cadal-geamhraidh a dhèanamh. Ach a-mhàin Oscar, a tha a’ cumail a-mach gu bheil esan cleachdte ris an fhuachd. Nuair a thèid Ealasaid a dh’iarraidh min-fhlùir air a caraidean, tha gaillean-shneachda a’ sèideadh gu cruaidh. As soon as it freezes, the bears go into hibernation - except for Ernest, who claims he’s accustomed to extreme temperatures. When Célestine goes to get some flour from her friends, a blizzard begins to blow.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Àtaidh a’ cur sìol chàil le solas na gealaich. Sa mhadainn tha cuid dhiubh air fàs mòr. Tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ cuideachadh aon chàl nach eil a’ fàs cho math, ach tha seo ag adhbharachadh staing. Abney plants seeds in the moonlight. By the morning, some have grown into lovely big cabbages. Abney and Teal decide to help one that is struggling, which leads to big trouble.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: An-diugh, 's e spùinneadairean a th'anns na h-Abadas, a' lorg ionmhas. Tha aon spùinneadair fortanach air an taghadh airson 'Acair' a lorg anns a' mhuir! Cò'n Abadas a thomhaiseas cò ris tha e coltach agus dè bhios e a' dèanamh? The Abadas are pirates, hunting for treasure. One lucky pirate is chosen to go in search of an anchor and explore the sea! Which Abada will guess what it looks like and what it actually does?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Tha Stella ‘son ‘s gum bi a h-athair mar na h-athraichean eile aig ball-coise – ach abair gu bheil daoine amharasach nuair a tha e a’ nochdadh gun a' chrùn air. Stella wants her father to be like the other dads at football, but there is much suspicion when he appears without his crown on.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair tha picnic rìoghail dol a ghabhail àite sa phàirc, tha Stella air a dearg nàrachadh, gun fhios nach fhaic a caraidean i an sin. Stella is really embarrassed in case friends see her when she is with her family at a royal picnic in the park.

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: Tha uisge pailt ann an Alba agus tha Calum air a’ Ghàidhealtachd far a bheil e a’ tadhal air Stèisean Cumhachd Foithir agus a’ coinneachadh ri fear de na seann tunnel tigers aig Dam Chluanaidh airson ionnsachadh mu chumhachd hydro. Water is rarely in short supply in Scotland and Calum is in the Highlands. He visits Foyers Power Station and meets a tunnel tiger at Cluanie Dam to learn more about hydroelectric power.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: Tha Grga a' miannachadh gum faigh e suas ann am bailiùn adhair theth ach, an toiseach, feumaidh e beagan busgaidh a dhèanamh gus an coisinn e gu leòr ‘son pàigheadh air a shon. Grga dreams of flying in a hot air balloon, but first he must do a little busking so he can earn enough to pay for it.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The arrival of potential Norwegian investor Johan throws a cat among the pigeons as age old family secrets and resentments come to the fore. The MacSween clan soon begin to realise that the mill is in worse shape than they thought and Seumas makes a surprise announcement to save the mill. Tha ruighinn, an neach-tasgaidh Nirribheach Johan a’ cur a' chiùil air feadh na fìdhle. Tha rùintean-dìomhair agus seann nàimhdeas an teaghlaich a’ togail ceann aon uair eile. Chan eil e a’ toirt fad sam bith mus tuig teaghlach MhicSuain gu bheil a’ mhuileann ann an staid fada nas miosa na bha iad an dùil agus tha a’ bheachd a th’ aig Seumas airson a’ mhuileann a shàbhaileadh a’ cur iongnadh orra uile. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Prosbaig
programme.desc: Bho mheadhan nan 80an bha am prògram telebhisein Prosbaig a' sgrùdadh chùisean na Gàidhealtachd 's nan Eilean, agus Alba san fharsaingeachd. Tron t-sreath seo, tha am fear-naidheachd Dòmhnall Moireasdan a' toirt sùil air ais tron tasglann agus a' toirt thugainn taghadh de na sgeulachdan a chaidh a chraoladh eadar 1984 agus 1988. Anns a' phrògram seo: rathad Rèinigeadail a' stad ann am meadhan na mòintich 's gun cinnt air airgead a chrìochnaicheadh e; cluais bhodhar do dh'iarrtasan muinntir Bheàrnaraigh airson cabhsair; agus eagal gun robh là nan klondykers ann an Ulapul a' tighinn gu ceann. From the mid 1980s, Gaelic current affairs television series Prosbaig covered many of the main stories making headlines in the Highlands and Islands and throughout Scotland. In this series, journalist Donald Morrison takes a look back through the archive and brings us some of the key stories from 1984 to 1988. In this programme: uncertainty surrounding the completion of the Rhenigidale Road midway through construction; the people of Berneray campaigning for a causeway; and fears that the prosperity the klondyker boom brought to Ullapool was nearing an end.

programme.title: Co-Sheirm
programme.desc: Sreath bhon tasglann a' taisbeanadh còisirean is guthan sònraichte. An t-seachdain-sa, Còisir Ghàidhlig Inbhir Nis. Archive series featuring choirs and outstanding soloists from The Inverness Gaelic Choir.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: Ramsay explores Comrie and Crieff for the weekend. Tha Ramsay eadar Comaraidh ‘s a Chraoibh son an deireadh-sheachdain.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the ‘Pretenders’, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Anna & Margaret or Marcas & Mia, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Anna & Margaret no Marcas & Mia, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr?

programme.title: Immigration Tracks
programme.desc: From Canada's Eastern province of Cape Breton, we embark on a road-trip east to Toronto, Ontario, in search of Scottish Gaelic families who settled in this vast country over 100 years ago. Anne meets the Rubilar family in Montreal. Originally from Chile, now they are searching for their great grandfather, Daniel Morrison from the Isle of Lewis. How do generations of Canadian Scots identify with their roots? Join Anne McAlpine on a cultural voyage of discovery. Tha Anne a’ coinneachadh ris an teaghlach Rubilar ann am Montreal. À Chile bho thùs, tha ceangal Albannach aca is iad airson barrachd fhaighinn a-mach mun t-seann seanair, Daniel Moireasdan à Eilean Leòdhais.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2025 agus a’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Ciorstaidh Pheutan, Eric Bibb, Loudon Wainwright III, Kíla agus Joshua Burnside. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2025, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Ciorstaidh Beaton, Eric Bibb, Loudon Wainwright III, Kíla and Joshua Burnside. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Third Lanark
programme.desc: Ann an 1967, agus e faisg air ceud bliadhna a dh'aois, chaidh cluba ball-coise le eachdraidh shòisealta is chultarail sònraichte à bith. As dèidh 95 bliadhna de dh'eachdraidh phròiseil chaidh innse gun robh Cluba Lùth-chleasachd Third Lanark banc-briste, agus chaidh na geataichean gu Pàirce Chathkin an dùnadh airson an turas mu dheireadh. Tha Third Lanark ag innse an sgeulachd mu dheidhinn cluba coimhearsnachd sònraichte, a' coimhead ri mar a chaidh a stèidheachadh, na làithean buidhe a thuilleadh air na làithean a bu dhuirche an uair a chaidh an cluba à bith. In 1967, as it edged towards its centenary, a much-loved social and cultural institution was consigned to history. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed. Third Lanark is the fascinating story of this iconic community club, exploring its formation and existence, as well as its catastrophic collapse.

programme.title: Sgeulachd Cogaidh na h-Artaig/Untold Arctic Wars
programme.desc: After World War II, the United States and the Soviet Union embark on a ruthless competition for control of the Arctic region.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Na Peatbog Faeries a’ toirt Duaisean nan Trads 2023 gu crìch le seata goirid. A’ gabhail a-steach The Jesster, Ann Robertson’s Kitchen agus Innes Drinks the Bru. Peatbog Faeries bring the Trad Awards 2023 to a close with this short concert set. The featured tracks include The Jesster, Ann Robertson’s Kitchen and Innes Drinks the Bru.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tha Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ oirbh chun a’ chiad latha de Belladrum 2025 is Natasha Bedingfield a’ nochdadh aig an fhèis airson a’ chiad uair air Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. Choinnich an saoghal ri Natasha an toiseach ann an 2004, is daoine measail oirre sa bhad le a guth sònraichte agus òrain tarraingeach a leithid ‘Unwritten’, a choisinn aire mòr-shluagh an t-saoghail. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome you to the first day at Belladrum 2025 as Natasha Bedingfield makes her festival debut on the Hot House Stage. The world first met Natasha in 2004. She became instantly popular, with a distinctive voice and smash hits such as Unwritten winning fans the world over.

programme.title: Dusty Springfield at the BBC
programme.desc: A second chance to explore the BBC’s archives with one of British music’s biggest and best-loved stars, Dusty Springfield. The great soul diva and her haunting voice are captured once again in selection of BBC performances from over the years, including You Don’t Have to Say You Love Me, Son of a Preacher Man, and Bacharach and David’s Look of Love. Together, these songs underline why Dusty earned her reputation as one of pop’s great talents, who deserves her ranking alongside fellow singing legends like Aretha Franklin and Dionne Warwick.

programme.desc: The Platinum Coast of Barbados is known for its golden sands and wealthy inhabitants. programme.desc: It started with the seizure of illegal cigarettes hidden in the back room of a minimart in Rochdale and ended with cocaine being bought over the counter from a shop in the West Midlands. Over a year, BBC news investigated the crime happening in plain sight on high streets across the country and, in the process, exposed the crime gangs exploiting the vulnerable and setting up shop in Britain.

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: A dispute around the latest series of I’m a Celebrity… Get Me Out of Here has drawn attention to how reality television is edited. Some contestants have said that footage was cut in a misleading way, affecting how they were shown on screen. The broadcaster ITV has said the programme reflects events fairly and accurately. Lauren Morris, culture news editor at The Independent, alongside reality television producers Donald Clarke and Rob Davis discuss the processes and standards used in production. King Charles’s state visit to the US has taken place at a time of diplomatic tension, following criticism from President Trump over the UK’s position on the war with Iran. The visit, the first by a British monarch in nearly two decades, involved a series of carefully planned public events and took place under heightened security. Sean Coughlan, royal correspondent at BBC News, and Jack Blanchard, author of POLITICO’s Playbook newsletter, outline their reporting approaches and editorial context.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: Adventurer and UK Chief Scout, Dwayne Fields embarks on a journey through Zambia. In the past decade, the African nation has become one of the fastest emerging tourist destinations on the continent. And to kick off, Dwayne heads to its most recognisable, and most visited attraction, Victoria Falls. He explores the foaming rapids at the base of the waterfall, before heading to the country's lively capital Lusaka to take part in a traditional pre-wedding ceremony. He ends his adventure in the remote interior where he witnesses the world's largest mammal migration - the arrival of 10 million fruit bats at Kasanka National Park.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Water has been a flashpoint in the Middle East and worldwide demand is outstripping supply, so how do we make sure there's enough to go round? This most basic resource is vital for drinking, sanitation and agriculture, but also for jobs and economies everywhere. The World Bank's global director for water Saroj Kumar Jha explains why they're trying to make it more of a priority for government spending. And Mareen Schneider, the founder and CEO of project developer Grasshopper Investments, explains how she's coming up with radical new ways for the private sector to invest in water. Plus, Ben Thompson also hears from José Manuel Entrecanales, the CEO of Spanish infrastructure giant Acciona, about the projects they're building around the world and why we need to rethink the value we give to water.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded speaks to leading tech podcaster Scott Galloway about the growing controversy surrounding Anthropic's latest AI model, Claude Mythos. During testing, the system uncovered thousands of hidden vulnerabilities in the software underpinning most of the world's computers - prompting Anthropic to decide it was too dangerous to release. The company says Mythos can outperform humans at certain hacking and cyber security tasks, raising fresh concerns among regulators, lawmakers and financial institutions about the risks to global digital infrastructure.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Phil Wang, dating expert Anna Williamson, actor and comedian Miles Jupp and actor Jamie-Lee O’Donnell as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Phil Wang, dating expert Anna Williamson, actor and comedian Miles Jupp and actor Jamie-Lee O’Donnell as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: The Weakest Link
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan is at the helm of one of the world’s most iconic quizzes. This episode is a TV medics special. The eight celebrities must initially work together to bank as much money as possible for charity before voting off one player per round as the weakest link. Only one player will be crowned the strongest link and take home the prize for their charity. The celebrity contestants in this episode are Dr Ranj Singh, Kirsty Mitchell from Casualty, Dr Xand van Tulleken, Dr Amir Khan, Renee Bailey from Call the Midwife, Rosie Marcel from Holby City, Wendi Peters from Doctors and Dr Linda Papadopoulos.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Phil Wang, dating expert Anna Williamson, actor and comedian Miles Jupp and actor Jamie-Lee O’Donnell as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

The eight celebrities must initially work together to bank as much money as possible for charity before voting off one player per round as the weakest link. Only one player will be crowned the strongest link and take home the prize for their charity. programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Phil Wang, dating expert Anna Williamson, actor and comedian Miles Jupp and actor Jamie-Lee O’Donnell as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Scotland's Home of the Year
programme.desc: Interior designers Anna Campbell Jones and Banjo Beale and architect Danny Campbell travel the country in search of Scotland's best homes. In the west, the judges must choose between a Georgian townhouse in Ayr, a semi-detached house in Dumbreck and a Victorian villa in Kilmacolm. Scoring them on architectural merit, distinctive design and personal style, which home will Anna, Banjo and Danny judge worthy enough to go forward to the grand final?

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will and Dan tackle a scale model of the world’s only rotating boat lift: the Falkirk Wheel. There are missing cogs and broken bearings, while an underperforming motor demand precision repairs. In the barn, Dom entrusts Wappy - a soft toy that saw Robbie through life-saving treatment in Dundee - to Julie and Amanda for a sensitive rebuild, before Will swaps timber for silver as he makes a decorative bowl with celebrated silversmith Katie Watson.

programme.title: Schemers
programme.desc: Davie (Conor Berry) is a dreamer from the council schemes, constantly hustling for his next buck then losing it on the horses. After a football injury, Davie falls for trainee nurse Shona (Tara Lee) and tries to impress her by running a disco. Along with friends John and Scot, Davie starts promoting bands, culminating in a hugely ambitious Iron Maiden gig at Caird Hall in Dundee.

programme.title: Susie McCabe: Femme Fatality
programme.desc: Acclaimed stand-up Susie McCabe brings her sensational show Femme Fatality to a sold-out King’s Theatre in Glasgow. From growing up gay in the 80s and 90s, to working on building sites and becoming a successful stand-up comic, Susie McCabe's life is jam-packed with rich material, and the gifted performer delivers a barnstorming evening of razor-sharp punchlines and observational comedy.

programme.title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
programme.desc: Dr David’s victims begin comparing their stories, and it becomes clear they are dealing with a sophisticated catfish. But nothing could prepare them for the shocking truth of the perpetrator’s true identity, which leaves the women with more questions than answers. But when beauty queen Abbie takes these findings to the police, they are unable to do anything about it, and the Catfish of Kilmarnock remains free to target more and more victims. Abbie can’t walk away, and steps up her investigation over months that turn into years. As she continues to track the catfish, the scale of their criminality comes into focus, with victims spread across the country and dating back over a decade. This is one of the UK’s most prolific ever catfish, and they are not done yet.

programme.title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
programme.desc: As criminal investigations take hold, the victims finally have justice, but they are still left urgently searching for answers as they try to rebuild their lives. What drives someone, with a seemingly normal life, to throw it all away to terrorise countless women from the same town? With no clear motive and no explanation from the person in the frame, this very modern true crime tale now turns to those closest to the perpetrator, who are also trying to understand the mystery behind the repeated cycles of offending. As the beauty queen and the catfish’s lives become ever more entangled, lines begin to blur, loyalties are tested, and Abbie finds herself questioning everything as history repeats, and the moral complexity of crime and punishment in the internet age is laid bare. For the many victims, the question remains: what drives someone to become one of the UK’s most prolific catfish - and why can’t they stop?

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: When a historical documentary team comes to film at Button House, Alison and the ghosts are shocked to discover that the assassination plot they are investigating involved one of their own. Meanwhile, Mike - always on the lookout for free publicity - begs Alison to accept the offer of a television interview about the old house. The only hitch is that Alison is terrified of speaking on camera. Luckily, Thomas is there to coach her in the art of speechmaking. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: A mysterious visitor arrives at Button House with a revelation that leaves Alison reeling. Thomas is equally confused by his feelings for this strange visitor, while Lady Button and Julian warn of sinister motives, and Kitty is as territorial as ever over her surrogate sister Alison. Mike has an epiphany on his first day at a new job, which triggers Julian to remember his first day as a ghost. But will their insights be enough to help Alison make sense of the overwhelming news she has received?

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda isn't your average girly girl. At 6ft 1in, Miranda gets called 'sir' once too often, much to the amusement of her childhood friend Stevie, who manages Miranda's joke shop. Miranda's mother Penny is disappointed that Miranda runs a joke shop rather than having a proper job. Penny bumps into one of Miranda's old school friends, Tilly, and lies that Miranda has a great new job, so Miranda decides to prove everyone wrong and find a new career. After getting caught by Tilly while helping out as a waitress, she decides to come clean and be proud of her real job, but, thanks to Gary, Tilly jumps to a surprising conclusion about Miranda's employment.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda knows she is not exactly cool, but being young, free and single has its advantages, like jetting off to Thailand on holiday for a few days. Although when it comes down to it, she would rather not bother with the hassle of going quite so far, so she books herself into a hotel across the road instead. She thoroughly enjoys the hotel, and even makes new friends with helpful porter Jason and conference organiser Colin. As her stay goes on, she literally becomes a new woman.

programme.title: Quiz Lady
programme.desc: A game show-obsessed young woman and her estranged train wreck of a sister must work together to help cover their mother’s gambling debts. Together, they set out on a wild, cross-country trek to get the cash the only way they know – by becoming bona fide game show champions.

programme.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
programme.desc: Janet and Donna compete for a job managing the pub. Louise buys a car with her mother's legacy. Jonny realises that Gaz is the father of Corinthian and gives him to Gaz, until Gaz reveals that Corinthian can't be his due to his low sperm count.

programme.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
programme.desc: Janet starts her job as manager of The Archer and gives the pub a World War Two theme to appeal to the grey pound. Donna is intent on revenge, Jonny tries to help Gaz become a dad, and Louise becomes a prostitute.

This is one of the UK’s most prolific ever catfish, and they are not done yet.

programme.title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
programme.desc: As criminal investigations take hold, the victims finally have justice, but they are still left urgently searching for answers as they try to rebuild their lives. What drives someone, with a seemingly normal life, to throw it all away to terrorise countless women from the same town? With no clear motive and no explanation from the person in the frame, this very modern true crime tale now turns to those closest to the perpetrator, who are also trying to understand the mystery behind the repeated cycles of offending. As the beauty queen and the catfish’s lives become ever more entangled, lines begin to blur, loyalties are tested, and Abbie finds herself questioning everything as history repeats, and the moral complexity of crime and punishment in the internet age is laid bare. For the many victims, the question remains: what drives someone to become one of the UK’s most prolific catfish - and why can’t they stop?

programme.title: Stacey Dooley
programme.desc: Invited into the traditionally private Gypsy community, Stacey discovers the complex balancing act young women face growing up in one of Britain’s most maligned ethnic minorities.

programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: When the Doctor arrives in Victorian London he finds a dinosaur rampant in the Thames and a spate of deadly spontaneous combustions. Who is the new Doctor and will Clara's friendship with him survive as they embark on a terrifying mission into the heart of an alien conspiracy? The Doctor has changed. It's time you knew him.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: When a historical documentary team comes to film at Button House, Alison and the ghosts are shocked to discover that the assassination plot they are investigating involved one of their own. Meanwhile, Mike - always on the lookout for free publicity - begs Alison to accept the offer of a television interview about the old house. The only hitch is that Alison is terrified of speaking on camera. Luckily, Thomas is there to coach her in the art of speechmaking. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: A mysterious visitor arrives at Button House with a revelation that leaves Alison reeling. Thomas is equally confused by his feelings for this strange visitor, while Lady Button and Julian warn of sinister motives, and Kitty is as territorial as ever over her surrogate sister Alison. Mike has an epiphany on his first day at a new job, which triggers Julian to remember his first day as a ghost. But will their insights be enough to help Alison make sense of the overwhelming news she has received?

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda isn't your average girly girl. At 6ft 1in, Miranda gets called 'sir' once too often, much to the amusement of her childhood friend Stevie, who manages Miranda's joke shop. Miranda's mother Penny is disappointed that Miranda runs a joke shop rather than having a proper job. Penny bumps into one of Miranda's old school friends, Tilly, and lies that Miranda has a great new job, so Miranda decides to prove everyone wrong and find a new career. After getting caught by Tilly while helping out as a waitress, she decides to come clean and be proud of her real job, but, thanks to Gary, Tilly jumps to a surprising conclusion about Miranda's employment.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda knows she is not exactly cool, but being young, free and single has its advantages, like jetting off to Thailand on holiday for a few days. Although when it comes down to it, she would rather not bother with the hassle of going quite so far, so she books herself into a hotel across the road instead. She thoroughly enjoys the hotel, and even makes new friends with helpful porter Jason and conference organiser Colin. As her stay goes on, she literally becomes a new woman.

programme.title: Quiz Lady
programme.desc: A game show-obsessed young woman and her estranged train wreck of a sister must work together to help cover their mother’s gambling debts. Together, they set out on a wild, cross-country trek to get the cash the only way they know – by becoming bona fide game show champions.

programme.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
programme.desc: Janet and Donna compete for a job managing the pub. Louise buys a car with her mother's legacy. Jonny realises that Gaz is the father of Corinthian and gives him to Gaz, until Gaz reveals that Corinthian can't be his due to his low sperm count.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is busy this week as the garden bursts into colour. Woody herbs such as thyme and sage don’t thrive in his clay soil, so he’s sowing seeds to ensure a steady supply. He’s planting grasses in the new Woodland Garden and creating a colourful pot for shade, and there's advice on what to do with this year’s daffodil bulbs. Carol Klein proves that small can be both beautiful and delicious, creating a modest border devoted to vegetables and weaving it together with flowers to provide year round colour. And Advolly Richmond heads to Fife to uncover the story of the first pink cupped daffodil, bred in the early 1900s and still growing today thanks to two passionate plantswomen. There’s a visit to a specialist nursery in Hertfordshire. With help from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, they are preparing to exhibit trees fit for a changing climate at the RHS Chelsea Flower show. And it's all aboard a houseboat that's jam-packed with plants.

programme.title: The Best Dishes Ever
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott introduces a selection of classic recipes from some of the BBC's best-loved television chefs. Ainsley looks at homemade meals that you normally turn to when you are craving a takeaway. The menu includes fish and chips from James Martin, a pizza recipe from Keith Floyd, a curry from Lorraine Pascale, Nigel Slater's Chinese chicken thighs and the Hairy Bikers' take on a pork chow mein.

programme.title: UEFA Women's Champions League
programme.desc: Live coverage as Lyon take on Arsenal in the Women's Champions League.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from the heart of Birmingham and its historic museum and art gallery. Antiques experts Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant are searching the queue for the best antiques and collectibles to take to auction. Paul Martin explores the museum's world-class collection of pre-Raphaelite art and discovers the work of arts and crafts jewellery designers Arthur and Georgie Gaskin. Paul also visits Hagley Hall, the last great palladian house to be built in Britain.

programme.title: Extraordinary Portraits
programme.desc: A rare medical condition meant Grace was unable to give birth, as she was born without a womb. But in a landmark moment for British medical history, her sister Amy made an extraordinary decision: to donate her womb to her sister in a complicated and involved operation, which lasted hours. Just months after the transplant, Grace became pregnant and now, with her husband, has a healthy daughter. It was a gift that transformed not only the sisters’ lives but those of everyone around them in a story of love, sacrifice and a deep family bond. Bill Bailey pairs Grace and Amy with Karen Turner, an award-winning artist with a powerful commitment to telling women’s stories. Karen works using an unusual and unforgiving technique, painting directly onto raw canvas. With no background layer and no possibility of correction, every paint stroke must be right. As Karen begins her work, she faces a profound challenge: how to capture the depth of love, trust and sacrifice that made this miracle possible. Can she find a way to express not just the medical achievement but the emotional truth behind it and create a portrait worthy of this remarkable act of sisterhood?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Tough-talking Dom Littlewood and consumer champion Melinda Messenger turn their hand to antique dealing. Have Hampshire’s antique dealers met their match? In a break from hunting down cowboy builders and exposing wrongs, Dom and Melinda are in hot pursuit of profitable antiques. With £400 and a classic car, they’re paired with antiques experts Natasha Raskin Sharp and Tim Medhurst.

programme.title: Snooker: World Championship
programme.desc: Coverage of day 15 of the World Snooker Championship at the Crucible Theatre, Sheffield.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: The Top of the Pops vaults are opened up to relive some of the classic and biggest songs of 1992. Featuring the hip-hop and dance of Kris Kross, SL2, Bizarre Inc and Felix to the rock stylings of Manic Street Preachers and Primal Scream, as well as the emergence of boy band royalty Take That, Miley’s dad Billy Ray getting the line dancing going, divas in the form of Annie Lennox and Mariah Carey - and, of course, Jimmy Nail. Plus many more.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: A look back at some of the songs performed on the show in 1993. Dance music and Euro pop continued to dominate the charts with performances from Haddaway, Sub Sub, Ace of Base and Robin S. The early stages of Britpop begin to emerge with Suede and Radiohead, and Icelandic superstar Björk makes an early appearance. Then there are the big sellers from Meat Loaf and Gabrielle, and the grooves come courtesy of Jamiroquai, Chaka Demus & Pliers and many more.

programme.title: Black Box
programme.desc: Obsessive forensic analyst Mathieu Vasseur is disappointed to be sidelined in the examination of the black box of an Atrian 800 airliner which has mysteriously crashed in the Alps. When his boss goes missing, Mathieu is asked to step in, and he concludes that there was an unauthorised entry into the cockpit. A press conference is held to announce the findings, but Mathieu is subsequently presented with conflicting evidence. French thriller with English subtitles.

programme.title: Weather Watchers with Barra Best
programme.desc: 'Everybody talks about the weather but nobody does anything about it' is a witticism attributed to writer Mark Twain. In the first of a two-part series, Barra Best experiences how our climate shapes our lives and discovers that while we can't do anything about the weather, we can certainly do things with it.

programme.title: Irish Cup
programme.desc: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage of the 2026 Irish Cup final between Dungannon Swifts and Coleraine. Holders Dungannon Swifts return to the showpiece final aiming for back-to-back triumphs, while Coleraine chase a first Irish Cup success since 2018. It's one of the biggest days in the Northern Ireland football calendar, with both sides aiming to etch their name onto the famous Irish Cup trophy.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Sperrins
programme.desc: In Gortin Glen Forest Park, walking guide Sean Harpur and his guide dog Bennie are on their daily walk and uncovering more of the woodland’s hidden history. And the restored clock is welcomed back to the tower at Lissan House.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre’s Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula makes the perfect comfort food: beef olives with onion gravy and creamy mash. She then drives to Kilkeel to meet two young broadcasters from Fuse FM, a community radio station. Against the stunning backdrop of the Mournes, Paula cooks monkfish with potato bread chips and a seaweed flavoured mayo. As a finale, Paula returns to her north coast kitchen to make ecclefechan tart and nutmeg custard.

programme.title: Weather Watchers with Barra Best
programme.desc: 'Everybody talks about the weather but nobody does anything about it' is a witticism attributed to writer Mark Twain. In the first of a two-part series, Barra Best experiences how our climate shapes our lives and discovers that while we can't do anything about the weather, we can certainly do things with it.

programme.title: Irish Cup
programme.desc: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage of the 2026 Irish Cup final between Dungannon Swifts and Coleraine. Holders Dungannon Swifts return to the showpiece final aiming for back-to-back triumphs, while Coleraine chase a first Irish Cup success since 2018. It's one of the biggest days in the Northern Ireland football calendar, with both sides aiming to etch their name onto the famous Irish Cup trophy.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Sperrins
programme.desc: In Gortin Glen Forest Park, walking guide Sean Harpur and his guide dog Bennie are on their daily walk and uncovering more of the woodland’s hidden history. And the restored clock is welcomed back to the tower at Lissan House.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre’s Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula makes the perfect comfort food: beef olives with onion gravy and creamy mash. She then drives to Kilkeel to meet two young broadcasters from Fuse FM, a community radio station. Against the stunning backdrop of the Mournes, Paula cooks monkfish with potato bread chips and a seaweed flavoured mayo. As a finale, Paula returns to her north coast kitchen to make ecclefechan tart and nutmeg custard.

programme.title: Extraordinary Portraits
programme.desc: A rare medical condition meant Grace was unable to give birth, as she was born without a womb. But in a landmark moment for British medical history, her sister Amy made an extraordinary decision: to donate her womb to her sister in a complicated and involved operation, which lasted hours. Just months after the transplant, Grace became pregnant and now, with her husband, has a healthy daughter. It was a gift that transformed not only the sisters’ lives but those of everyone around them in a story of love, sacrifice and a deep family bond. Bill Bailey pairs Grace and Amy with Karen Turner, an award-winning artist with a powerful commitment to telling women’s stories. Karen works using an unusual and unforgiving technique, painting directly onto raw canvas. With no background layer and no possibility of correction, every paint stroke must be right. As Karen begins her work, she faces a profound challenge: how to capture the depth of love, trust and sacrifice that made this miracle possible. Can she find a way to express not just the medical achievement but the emotional truth behind it and create a portrait worthy of this remarkable act of sisterhood?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Tough-talking Dom Littlewood and consumer champion Melinda Messenger turn their hand to antique dealing. Have Hampshire’s antique dealers met their match? With £400 and a classic car, they’re paired with antiques experts Natasha Raskin Sharp and Tim Medhurst.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

Florist Simon Lycett is celebrating what would have been her late Majesty’s 100th birthday with a bouquet of her favourite flowers, we visit the fox rescue centre helping injured foxes and cubs, and we meet Poppy the Pedigree Sussex cow who made headlines when she ran amok at Clarence House.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: Endeavour
programme.desc: Crime drama series about the young Detective Constable Endeavour Morse. May 1966 - Endeavour returns to Oxford City Police after a four-month absence from duty and is reunited with Thursday. Meanwhile, a Broad Street parade celebrating the might of Britain's military accomplishments is soured by a rash student stunt and thrown into sharp relief when an anonymous man plummets to his death from a nearby council building - a clutch of business cards bearing multiple identities suggest the death was more than just a routine suicide, and Endeavour flexes his gumshoe muscles to uncover the corpse's identity in a solitary pursuit that builds to a trip to London with troubling consequences. As a concerned Thursday looks on, the young Morse pulls two seemingly unrelated cases into the fray - an anguished father who is searching for a missing daughter and a smash-and-grab robbery of medieval artefacts at Oxford's Beaufort College - as he risks all to bring those responsible to justice.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.desc: Crime thriller featuring the author's much-loved spinster sleuth. Lymstock is a town with more than its share of shameful secrets, a town where even a sudden outbreak of anonymous hate mail causes only a minor stir - however, Miss Marple believes that there is more to the case than meets the eye when Mona Symmington takes her own life as a result of one of the letters. The town is thrown into turmoil as the letters become ever more deadly - someone local must be responsible, so can anyone be trusted?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Tom Barnaby and DS Ben Jones investigate a land feud involving two farming dynasties which explodes into violence - trouble seems to be brewing in the pretty village of Ford Florey when a tract of waste ground dubbed the Swamp becomes the focus of a land dispute between two old agricultural families. Tensions are increased further after a band of travellers also lay claim to the site with a view to developing it into a place where they can settle - matters come to a head at the town's annual Fayre. While some villagers are taking part in a shootout reconstruction at a Wild West show, a woman is shot for real - she turns out to be the farm manager for one of the feuding families and the timing of her death raises questions. Barnaby and Jones launch a murder investigation and uncover a series of seething grudges within the village before another person is killed - does the Swamp hold the key to identifying the murderer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Barnaby's wife Joyce swerves her car to narrowly miss a shadowy figure in the road... or so she thinks. Later that night a body is discovered in the old cemetery - did Joyce hit someone after all, or was the victim - who seems to have plenty of enemies - killed by one of the villagers? Barnaby and Jones have their work cut out as all the villagers seem to be hiding something, but is it murder?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Piano student Zoe Stock has won a place at the Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding when, from the riverbank in the grounds of the manor, she sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater - when Barnaby and Jones start investigating the possible drowning, they discover unsavoury connections to the past that could prove lethal 20 years later. Can they intervene before the body count escalates, and will the talented Zoe survive her master class?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Betrayal, infidelity and blackmail fester as plans to re-enact a Victorian prizefight turn nasty - and even DCI Barnaby finds his judgement clouded by an old friend. Midsomer Morchard prepares to welcome back local boxer John Kinsella from his world title fight victory in New York - Kinsella is returning with his ruthless and controlling promoter Frank Bishop to take part in a re-enactment of a match from 1860. When Bishop arrives, he goes to see solicitor Giles Braithwaite but instead finds the lawyer dead - meanwhile, trainer Teddy Molloy is working with another fighter called Ken Tuohy, who suspects Kinsella of a dalliance with his fiancee. There are plenty of other grudges and secrets simmering in the village, with revelations of discord, adultery, gambling and Giles's assistant Iris being accused of blackmail. When it comes time for the re-enactment, Tuohy takes the place of Kinsella's opponent and attacks Kinsella - Bishop is then found dead. Can Barnaby find the killer?

programme.title: Grace
programme.desc: Crime drama. The murder of a woman discovered in her flat initially presents as a break-in gone wrong but soon appears to be something more and leads Grace to question whether this attack was targeted - the victim Hannah Belling, a psychiatrist and founder of a popular mental health app, was well liked, but it becomes clear that she had enemies as Grace delves deeper. A number of compelling suspects present themselves - an ex-husband causing an acrimonious divorce, an obsessive stalker fired from Hannah's company, a missing brother with a criminal past, and a mysterious lover as the team also discover that Hannah's office was broken into a few days before her death - did she have something that her attacker would kill for? When blood found in Hannah's flat then reveals a chilling discovery, Roy realises that Hannah's killer is just within reach and that her death isn't the only secret they are keeping as the painful truth at the heart of the murder turns Grace's world upside down.

programme.title: A Touch of Frost
programme.desc: DI Frost investigates if three male bodies found buried naked in the shape of a triangle are part of a satanic ritual, but will closer analysis lead him in a different direction? Meanwhile, ruthless millionaire press baron James Callum is determined to make his mark on Denton and will stop at nothing to get what he wants - will Frost be able to stop Callum in his tracks before his actions lead to fatal consequences?
